title: Quill & Fern
text: Calm vegetarian dining room with a short seasonal menu, low lighting and no music after eight.

title: The Copper Marrow
text: Loud open-fire grill built around aged beef and bone marrow, with a long bar and a queue most nights.

title: Saltmarsh Table
text: Quiet fish restaurant doing line-caught cod, sea bass and mackerel with a daily blackboard of sides.

title: Harbour Claw
text: Shellfish counter serving oysters, langoustine and crab, with a lively standing bar at the front.

title: Green Lantern Rooms
text: Vegetarian and vegan tasting menu in a small room, relaxed service, everything cooked over charcoal.

title: Murrow Street Canteen
text: Cheap and quick vegetarian canteen with rice bowls, dhal and a rotating salad counter. Communal tables.

title: The Slow Kiln
text: Wood-fired sourdough pizza and a short vegetarian list, quiet on weeknights, terrace out the back.

title: North Quay Grill
text: Riverside grill with steak, whole grilled sea bass and a wine list longer than the food menu.

title: Wren & Thistle
text: Quiet neighbourhood bistro, mostly vegetarian, candlelit, the kind of place you can hear the table.

title: Chalkline Noodle Bar
text: Fast hand-pulled noodles with plenty of vegetarian bowls, bright lights and a constant kitchen clatter.

title: The Tidewell
text: Small seafood room built around a shellfish tank, oysters by the dozen and a whole crab special.

title: Ottermill Kitchen
text: Relaxed all-day kitchen, big vegetarian section, good grilled trout, low tables and soft lighting.

title: Brass & Barley
text: Beer hall with a short menu of burgers and wings, screens on every wall, extremely loud at weekends.

title: Aster & Oak
text: Seasonal vegetarian plates in a converted workshop, quiet, unhurried, a single sitting each evening.

title: Pellham Fry
text: Old-fashioned fish and chips, cod and haddock fried to order, wooden benches, nothing quiet about it.

title: Lume Dining Room
text: Expensive tasting menu, fifteen courses, largely vegetarian with a fish supplement, near silent room.

title: The Corner Mezze
text: Small plates, plenty of vegetarian, warm and busy but you can still talk. Grilled sardines are the draw.

title: Vellum Cafe
text: Daytime vegetarian cafe, closes at six, cheap plates and very good bread. Quiet after the lunch rush.

title: Stanmere House
text: Formal dining room, classic French, heavy on meat and butter, a jacket is expected and it is very quiet.

title: Harlow Fish Bar
text: Counter service seafood, grilled mackerel and tuna steaks, cheap wine, a bit loud but very fast.

title: The Quiet Plum
text: Twelve seats, vegetarian, no music, no phones, one menu each night. Booking opens a month ahead.

title: Kettleworth Arms
text: Pub with a proper kitchen, a decent vegetarian roast and a grilled trout, noisy front bar, calm back room.

title: Sable & Sage
text: Modern Indian, largely vegetarian, warm dining room with soft music and a well-priced set lunch.

title: Drumlin Steakhouse
text: Steak, steak and more steak. One vegetarian option. Booths, loud music, open until two in the morning.
